title: KHR_environment_sky Panorama Sky Parameters
description: Panorama skies use a texture or set of textures to represent the sky.

cubemap.description: The indices of 6 textures making up a cubemap in the glTF `textures` array, in KTX 2.0 face order and orientation (+X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z), where KTX's +X axis points in glTF's -X direction.

equirectangular.description: The index of an equirectangular panorama texture in the glTF `textures` array.
